inset.$value: inset 0 1px 2px light-dark(oklch(from var(--sc, {elevation.color}) l c h / calc(8% * var(--so, 1))), oklch(from var(--sc, {elevation.color}) l c h / calc(26% * var(--so, 1))))
inset.$description: An inward shadow, for wells and pressed states.

color.$description: The colour every shadow is tinted from. Set it to a hue and the whole elevation scale warms or cools with it.

strength.$description: Multiplies every shadow layer’s alpha. Dark mode is pinned to 2.4 by scss/_root.scss and no token map can reach it; a page with an explicit data-bs-theme needs a CSS rule as well as the Sass override. See docs/BACKLOG.md U4.

elevation.$description: Shadow scale plus the colour and strength every layer is tinted by.
